    tl_vals = f[:, 0, 0]
    tr_vals = f[:, 0, 2]
    bl_vals = f[:, 2, 0]
    br_vals = f[:, 2, 2]
    
    # Count channels where each corner has the max absolute value
    tl_max_count = 0
    tr_max_count = 0
    bl_max_count = 0

    for c in range(32):
        corners = [abs(tl_vals[c].item()), abs(tr_vals[c].item()), abs(bl_vals[c].item()), abs(br_vals[c].item())]
        max_idx = corners.index(max(corners))
        if max_idx == 0: tl_max_count += 1
        elif max_idx == 1: tr_max_count += 1
        elif max_idx == 2: bl_max_count += 1
        elif max_idx == 3: br_max_count += 1
    
    # Also check mean corner values
    tl_mean = tl_vals.mean().item()

    bl_mean = bl_vals.mean().item()

    fc_col = fc_w[:, j]

print("=== Filter purity (max_weight / sum_abs_weights) ===")

    if sum_abs > 0:
        ratio = max_w / sum_abs
        top_class = col.argmax().item()
        if ratio > 0.3:

# Also check the entropy of the weight distribution
import math
print("\n=== Filter weight entropy (low = dedicated) ===")
for j in range(64):
    col = fc_w[:, j]
    # Softmax to get distribution
    probs = torch.softmax(col.abs() * 10, dim=0)  # sharpened
    entropy = -(probs * torch.log(probs + 1e-10)).sum().item()
    max_w = col.max().item()
    top_class = col.argmax().item()
    if entropy < 1.5:  # low entropy = dedicated
        print(f"  Filter {j} -> Class {top_class}: entropy={entropy:.3f}, max_w={max_w:.3f}")
